text: Re-read 2026-08-17. Both fence comments verified against the body: load_existing(write_cache=False) at viz.py:174 and EdgeBuilder.load(..., write_cache=False) at :177. 'The fence is only as strong as its leakiest loader' is the exact lesson - there are two cache-warming loaders on this path and suppressing one leaves the other writing. That is how the earlier leaks survived, and the read fence test is what keeps this honest.
